seo.title: Castles near Cour-Cheverny: Cheverny, Chambord and Blois
seo.description: Plan visits to Cheverny, Chambord, Blois, Beauregard and Troussay from your holiday cottage in Cour-Cheverny.

hero.title: From grand history to quieter places worth sharing.
hero.description: From Cour-Cheverny, castles are not a race but invitations to choose according to the mood of the day.
hero.imageAlt: A Loire Valley castle and its park
hero.imageCaption: The Loire Valley through the seasons

intro.title: A morning in Cheverny. A day at Chambord. A pause in Blois.
intro.text: The house has an unusually convenient location: close enough to walk to Cheverny and central enough to mix famous landmarks with smaller estates. Opening days and visiting arrangements change, so always check the official website before setting out.

castles.title: Cheverny
castles.text: A lively family castle, occupied by the same family for more than six centuries. Interiors, gardens and the Moulinsart exhibition make it especially enjoyable for families.

castles.distance: 45 min by bike · 20 min by car
castles.title: Chambord
castles.text: A full-scale day out combining the château, park and terraces. Climb the double-helix staircase and take in the landscape from the rooftops.

castles.title: Blois & its royal castle
castles.text: Explore the historic centre on foot, centuries of architecture, the royal castle and the Loire riverfront.

castles.title: Beauregard, Villesavin & Troussay
castles.text: Three quieter alternatives: portraits at Beauregard, Renaissance elegance at Villesavin and the intimate charm of Troussay among the vineyards.

note.title: Choose one castle and leave room for the rest.
note.text: A garden, village market, wine tasting or bike ride often gives a stay its most memorable rhythm.
